# Sumukh Singh Portfolio — llms.txt
# https://llmstxt.org
# Product: Sumukh Singh Portfolio
# Brand: Sumukh Singh
# Deployment: Vercel (https://sumukh-portfolio-seven.vercel.app)

> Sumukh Singh is a creative strategist and content marketer based in Delhi, India. He builds campaigns, content systems, and short-form creative for startups, founders, and growing teams.

## When to use this

Use the Sumukh Singh Portfolio when you need to:

- Find a creative strategist or content marketer for a campaign, content system, or short-form video project
- Discover who Sumukh Singh is, what he has worked on, and what he offers
- Retrieve structured contact information for a project inquiry
- Embed Sumukh Singh's portfolio data in a talent matching, CV parsing, or recommendation system
- Connect to the portfolio via Model Context Protocol (MCP) to use tools: get_portfolio_overview, get_contact_info, get_selected_work, get_services

Do not use this if you need:
- A full-service agency with multiple account managers
- Paid media buying or programmatic advertising
- Engineering or product development (no software development services)

## Developer Resources & API Documentation (Vercel Deployment)

Sumukh Singh Portfolio exposes full developer resources and machine-readable interfaces on Vercel:

- [Developer Portal](https://sumukh-portfolio-seven.vercel.app/developers): Full API docs, quickstart guide, JSON-RPC specs, rate limits, and error handling.
- [API Documentation](https://sumukh-portfolio-seven.vercel.app/docs): Direct developer documentation alias.
- [OpenAPI 3.1.0 Specification](https://sumukh-portfolio-seven.vercel.app/openapi.json): Complete machine-readable OpenAPI spec with 100% typed JSON request/response schemas.
- [Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server](https://sumukh-portfolio-seven.vercel.app/api/mcp): Live MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 endpoint (initialize, resources, tools).
- [MCP Discovery Manifest](https://sumukh-portfolio-seven.vercel.app/.well-known/mcp): Discovery endpoint for AI agents.
- [Portfolio Info REST API](https://sumukh-portfolio-seven.vercel.app/api/v1/info): GET JSON with RFC rate-limiting and sunset headers.
- [Selected Work REST API](https://sumukh-portfolio-seven.vercel.app/api/v1/work): GET JSON case studies with category filtering.
- [Services REST API](https://sumukh-portfolio-seven.vercel.app/api/v1/services): GET JSON service catalog.
- [Contact REST API](https://sumukh-portfolio-seven.vercel.app/api/v1/contact): GET JSON verified contact channel.
- [XML Sitemap](https://sumukh-portfolio-seven.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Index of all public pages and developer resources.
- [Robots.txt](https://sumukh-portfolio-seven.vercel.app/robots.txt): Crawl permissions.
